title: Open and closed restrictions of coefficient-linear extension by zero
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, with coefficient ring objects $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and module objects as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion of schemes and $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion whose image is $X\setminus j(U)$. Use coefficient module pullbacks $g^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_g}\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*_{\Ab})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] and the coefficient-linear extension by zero $j_!$ [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. For every $M\in\Mod_{\Lambda_U}$ there are natural isomorphisms $j^*j_!M\cong M$ and $i^*j_!M\cong0$. No finiteness condition on $\Lambda$ or Noetherian condition on the schemes is required.

source.place: Proof: "On $U_a$ the restriction of $j_!M$ is $M|_{U_a}$, because $j^*j_!\cong\mathrm{id}$. On $X\setminus U$ it is $0$"; isolate the coefficient-category restriction identities.
